changelog: Fix migrations/2026_09_23_0001_create_report_card_tables.sql — migrate.php?mode=run failed with errno 150 ("Foreign key constraint is incorrectly formed") creating report_cards. Confirmed against live SHOW CREATE TABLE users: users.id is signed int(11), while this migration declared every user_id column INT UNSIGNED. Every user_id column that FKs to users(id) (report_cards, report_card_templates, report_card_mantras, report_card_ai_reviews) is now plain INT (signed), matching exactly. Also found and fixed the same mismatch on report_card_tickers.trade_id -> trades.id (never reached by the live run, since mode=run stops at the first failing statement) — confirmed signed by precedent in the already-shipped 2026_09_21_0008_create_trade_checkins.sql, which FKs to trades(id) the same way. Every in-file FK between two new report_card_* tables was checked too and needed no change (all self-consistently INT UNSIGNED already).

Every CREATE TABLE in that migration now uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, so a retry after a later table's failure can't fail again on an earlier table that already succeeded (DDL auto-commits per statement; this file runs outside a transaction).

This file was never successfully applied on live (mode=run stopped at the first statement), so editing it is the intended retry path, not a checksum-locked edit — see CLAUDE.md v3.12.2. Checked the Report Card PHP code (ReportCardController.php, ReportCardAiController.php): nothing assumes these columns are unsigned — every read/write goes through a prepared-statement placeholder and app-level values are already always positive (uid()/validId()) — so no PHP changes were needed.
release_notes: Redeploys the corrected migrations/2026_09_23_0001_create_report_card_tables.sql (fixes the errno 150 signedness mismatch against users.id/trades.id that failed the last mode=run) — the live migrations/ folder currently has the old, broken copy from v3.18.0 and needs this file re-synced before retrying. After Update Now: run migrate.php?mode=status to confirm it shows pending (not a checksum mismatch against the old copy's already-recorded 'failed' row, which is expected and retryable), then mode=run. Does not touch 2026_09_24_0001 — that migration is unrelated and still separately pending from v3.18.2.
